newsitem.title: CANADA: NEWCOURT GETS CIBC COMMCORP SHARE FOR 6 PCT STAKE.
newsitem.headline: NEWCOURT GETS CIBC COMMCORP SHARE FOR 6 PCT STAKE.

text.p: Newcourt Credit Group said on Thursday that it had agreed to surrender a six-percent shareholder stake to Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce in exchange for the Canadian bank's 46 percent interest in Commcorp Financial Services Inc.

The deal paves the way for Newcourt's outright purchase of all outstanding shares of Commcorp, one of Canada's largest asset finance companies, at an agreed price in cash and shares of about C$361 million (US$260.2 million).
"When you look at our respective strengths and industry specialties, there is an excellent strategic fit between the two companies,'' said Steven Hudson, Newcourt's president.
